furnace.role: REFINING pad: drop minerals; smelts 1 mineral -> 1 ingot (crit 2) one at a time; time = smeltSeconds / furnace speed stat; ingots pile on output (LOAD n)

salesStand.role: SELL pad: drop ingots only (raw minerals cannot be sold in main mode). Sales trucks arrive, fill up to a random target weight in [SalesTruckWeightMin, SalesTruckWeightMax] (upgrade 'Sales Trucks'), leave, and cash is stacked at the money place for the player to collect. Each ingot sold increments stage progress.

machineryShop.role: ENTER: buy light equipment (permanent) / rent heavy equipment (this stage only).

upgradeBuilding.role: OPEN: quarry stat upgrades (statUpgrades), paid in cash, no research time in main mode.

oilStation.role: Locked until a fuel-powered vehicle is rented; produces oil barrels (max 9 waiting) the player carries to vehicles; waste-oil bin next to it absorbs leftovers.

oreStorage.role: Minecart unload target at the rail end point; hands minerals to the player/carriers (BuildingStackingSender).

workerBuilding.role: Job board / worker management. Locked until hiring unlocks.

cafeteria.role: Workers with no stamina eat here to recover (tables unlock via RV).

structures.note: All stage structures are unlocked for free or by watching a rewarded ad (payType RV). Prices are 0.

notes: Only one quest card is active at a time; quests run strictly in NextId order.
Group 1 = stages 1-4 tutorial chain (a 'Contract a New Quarry' quest closes each stage). Group 2 then loops 6x, then group 1000 loops forever.
Rewards are raw amounts (e.g. 'Mount Wheelbarrow' = 25 cash, confirmed by gameplay video).
Quest group 3 (ids 3001-3057) exists in data but is not referenced by QuestGroupData; all its rewards are 1 cash (placeholder / A-B variant).

onboardingSequence.trigger: Game start in stage 1 (quest 1001 'Break Ores'). Ends when player's cargo is full (_isCargoFull). Speaker: Foreman Hank.
dialogue: Well, look who finally showed up!  Ready to smash some rocks?

onboardingSequence.trigger: After first cargo; camera guides to furnace. Ends when smelting finishes (_isSmelterDone).
dialogue: Nice haul! Can't sell 'em raw though —  head to the furnace and start smelting!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Pick up the ingot from the furnace output (_isIngotCollected).
Deliver ingot to the SELL pad (_isIngotDelivered).
Fires on quest 1005 'Go to Upgrade' (OnboardingCatalog.QUEST_ID_ENTER_UPGRADE=1005).
dialogue: You've saved enough — time to upgrade!  Better gear makes everything easier.

onboardingSequence.trigger: Fires on quest 1009 'Go to Machinery Center' (QUEST_ID_ENTER_SHOP=1009).
dialogue: You've got enough for new gear!  Let's go shopping!

onboardingSequence.trigger: First time inside the machinery shop.
dialogue: Buy light equipment or rent heavy equipment here.

onboardingSequence.trigger: After first light-equipment purchase (Sledgehammer, quest 1010); points to the equipment inventory.
dialogue: Nice, you got light equipment!  Once it's yours, it's yours forever.
Check your equipment inventory in the bottom menu to equip or unequip as needed.

onboardingSequence.trigger: After first rental (Wheelbarrow, quest 1015); vehicle spawns at base camp vehicle spawn points.
dialogue: Nice, you rented heavy equipment!  Yours for this stage — rent again next time.
Your equipment should be at base camp by now.  Go check it out!

onboardingSequence.trigger: First mount; explains the dismount button (only when fully stopped).
dialogue: Well, well! You mounted the heavy equipment!  Good work.
Getting off is just as easy — hit the dismount button.
One catch — the dismount button only appears when fully stopped.
Safety first!  Make sure you're fully stopped before dismounting. Every time!

onboardingSequence.trigger: When the first fuel-powered vehicle is rented the Oil Station unlocks (camera directing) + waste-oil bin.
dialogue: Grab the fuel from the tank, then dump the rest in the waste oil bin here.

onboardingSequence.trigger: First time a vehicle runs out of fuel; go to the Oil Station and carry fuel barrels.
dialogue: Uh oh, out of fuel.  It'll barely move without gas.
Till you rent a Fuel Truck, grab fuel barrels from base manually.  Go fill it up!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Hiring unlock (condition group 1003 = Stage 1 progress >= 20%; building label says 'STAGE 1 [40%]'). First hire is free; applicants are profile 3 (carrier) then 2 (miner).
dialogue: Getting tough solo, huh?  Let's hire some workers!
Applications come in from time to time. Keep an eye out — they won't wait forever!
I pulled some strings — cost is covered.  Just sign!
They work automatically till the stage ends — and can even use your light equipment!
Done here? Swing by the Worker Management building — I'll show you around!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Visit the Worker building; assign your light equipment to workers.
dialogue: Welcome! This is where you track and manage your workers.
Best part? Your workers can use your light equipment!  Let me show you.
They start with basic gear — just assign yours to the slot and they'll get right to work!
Free slot? Hit Equip. In use?  Exchange it. Take it back anytime you need it!
Not much gear now, but this'll come in handy later.  Let's get back to work!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Explains the cafeteria / stamina recovery.
dialogue: See the break area next door?  Workers rest there when their stamina runs out.
Stop by now and then with some food — it boosts morale.
Big crew?  Consider expanding the area — not enough seats and most won't get proper rest.

onboardingSequence.trigger: Company HQ (Management) unlock: COMPANY_LOCK_CONDITION_GROUP_ID=203 = Stage 1 progress >= 60%. Secretary Sofia intro.
dialogue: Quarry's running smooth!  I'm Sofia, your new Secretary.
Sorry to interrupt.  Come back to HQ when you're done. I'll be waiting.

onboardingSequence.trigger: Stage progress reaches 80% -> stage-clear button appears.
dialogue: You've met the stage clear condition!  Nice work!
Just so you know — that's the bare minimum.
You can move on, but cashing out your resources first pays off big.  Your call!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Press Next -> Management popup -> Contract Room -> pick next quarry.
dialogue: That's everything!  Ready to head back to the quarry?

onboardingSequence.trigger: Stage 2: Light Equipment Workshop opens (floor 2, StageLevel >= 2).
dialogue: What do you think of the new office?  Let's build it up together!
While you're here, let's check out light equipment upgrades!  This way!
This is the Light Equipment Workshop.  Upgrade your gear here — visit often!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Stage 2 progress >= 40%: Heavy Equipment Center opens (research costs Gear).
dialogue: Good news — the Heavy Equipment Center is ready!  Come back to HQ for a moment?
Research heavy equipment here at the Heavy Equipment Center.
Heavy equipment research is different — it needs Gear.  Want to try?
Nicely done!  Now get back out there and finish strong!

onboardingSequence.trigger: Cash-spending rebate (cashback) UI, active from stage 2.
dialogue: Great news, boss!  We're now earning rebates from our vendors!
Not bad, right?  Spend more, get more back!
Equipment, hiring, upgrades — hit the threshold and rewards are yours!
